request.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn it into an ice-age longship: the hull becomes dark brown-grey hide over wood, colour #493736 with #2d2b2b shadows; a bright ice-blue crystal figurehead on the bow; the red sail becomes a sail of shaggy warm white fur, colour #e3d5b7 shaded warm taupe #8c7667, never blue-grey; the pennant becomes a white fur tail. Keep the boat shape, mast, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
